===Colors===
The <code>type</code> parameter determines the color of the infobox. The options are:
*Athlete
*Bounty hunter
*Bureaucrat
*Chiss Ascendancy
*CIS
*Confederation
*Corporate
*Criminal
*Dark Jedi
*Dathomiri
*Eternal Empire
*First Order
*Galactic Empire
*Galactic Republic
*GFFA
*Hutt Cartel
*Infinite Empire
*Je'daii
*Jedi
*Mandalorian
*Musician
*New Republic
*Nihil
*Pet
*Rebel
*Resistance
*Sith
*Sith Empire
*Yuuzhan Vong

===Usage===
====Required parameters====
Paste the following code into the top of an article, filling all known fields:
<pre><nowiki>{{Top|}}
{{Droid
|type=
|image=
|name=
|homeworld=
|birth=
|death=
|creator=
|manufacturer=
|line=
|model=
|class=
|cost=
|length=
|width=
|height=
|mass=
|gender=
|pronouns=
|sensor=
|plating=
|armament=
|equipment=
|affiliation=
}}</nowiki></pre>

====Data Fields====
*type - See below.
*image - Put a clear image of the droid, unobscured by any items.
*name - Put the number designation of the droid, followed by its nickname in quotes after <nowiki><br /></nowiki> if the nickname is not a phonetic pronunciation of the designation (see [[Forum:CT:Alternate names in the infobox|Alternate names in the infobox]]), e.g. [[R5-D4]] has the nickname "Red", but [[L0-LA59]] does not have "Lola" in the infobox.
*homeworld - Put the droid's homeworld. 
*birth - Put the date the droid was created.
*death - Put the date the droid was destroyed.
*creator - Put the name of the person who built the droid, e.g. [[Anakin Skywalker]] was the creator of [[C-3PO]].
*manufacturer - Put the name of the company that manufactured the droid, e.g. [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]].
*line - Put the droid series of the droid, e.g. [[B-series battle droid]].
*model - Put the model series of the droid, e.g. [[B1-Series battle droid]].
*class - Put the class of droid - not the degree (e.g. fourth) but the function of the droid's model, e.g. [[Utility droid]].
*cost - Put the cost of the droid in credits.
*length - Put the length of the droid in whatever units the source(s) use.
*width - Put the width of the droid in whatever units the source(s) use.
*height - Put the height of the droid in whatever units the source(s) use.
*mass - Put the mass of the droid in whatever units the source(s) use.
*gender - Put the droid's programming gender, if any, e.g. [[Gender|Feminine programming]]
*pronouns - Put the pronouns used by the droid, e.g. He/him, It/its
*sensor - Put the colors of the droid's sensors.
*plating - Put the colors of the droid's plating.
*armament - Put the weaponry built into the droid.
*equipment - Put the equipment built into the droid.
*affiliation - Put the organizations the droid is affiliated with.
